title: How are these stats for my tower defense game? (iOS)
author: diox__
selftext:
I have spent six months polishing, have come a very long way from there. I have been waiting for two weeks now for Apple to release my latest build, already starting to work on Duo but not sure if I should just wait.

Anyway, are these stats good? 

I have used Claude for everything, and it has been exhausting to QA, but I’m finally in a place I’m happy about it. 

The most progress happened when opus 5.5 dropped  
2.0 was fable giving it a pass and then I’ve been working non stop since

I’ve set up a “Jarvis” so I can manage straight from my phone all the QA in an efficient way. 

Next build I will explore more use with elevenlabs and meshy. 

But 95% of this is thanks to Claude analyzing my endless QA feedback in rapid fire, one sentence at a time (don’t do this I burn a lot of tokens)

[Here is the game (iOS)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nexus-swarm-tower-defense-td/id6760966069)

comments.author: supimjay
comments.body: Following, did you do much marketing to acquire users? Going to try publishing to IOS myself in the coming months and want to understand the game a bit better

replies.author: diox__
replies.body:
Before iOS gaming locked down to mega thread on Saturdays I posted there like 2 or 3 times. I also posted some free promo codes very early on for free IAP, but I should’ve held off until later because I’ve changed so much since then.

And then I would just post every now and then when I remembered. 

I just started a tik tok channel and am using my own instagram to post videos just to see what sticks and works :)
